status_note: Observing only: this is a mechanical listing, not an evaluation of any institution or act.

acts_monthly.name: Legal acts published in the Official Journal (L series) whose English title contains the exact phrase, by month of OJ publication

query_definition.method: Publications Office Cellar SPARQL (public endpoint, metadata only)
query_definition.limitation: Title match only: the Cellar SPARQL endpoint holds metadata, not full text, so acts that mention artificial intelligence only in their body are not counted. Consolidated texts and non-OJ documents (proposals, communications, Parliament resolutions) are outside the definition.
query_definition.retrospective_note: Months and acts dated before observation_start were retrieved retrospectively (retrieved_retrospectively=true) on the day the series went live; they are kept apart from day-by-day observation. The month containing observation_start is partly retrospective.

ai_act_calendar.name: Staged application dates of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), as published in the Official Journal, including the amendment by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744

amendment.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
amendment.effect: Rewrites the third paragraph of Article 113 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (point (40)); adds Article 111(4).

stages.what: Entry into force (twentieth day following publication in the Official Journal)
Chapters I and II apply (general provisions; prohibited AI practices), except the prohibitions added by the 2026 amendment
stages.basis: Reg. 2024/1689, Art. 113(a) as amended by Reg. 2026/1744 point (40)

stages.what: Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V (general-purpose AI models), Chapter VII, Chapter XII and Article 78 apply, with the exception of Article 101
Articles 102 to 110 apply (amendments to other Union acts)
stages.basis: Reg. 2024/1689, Art. 113(d) as inserted by Reg. 2026/1744 point (40)

stages.what: General date of application of the Regulation

Article 5(1), first subparagraph, points (ba) and (bb), and Article 5(1a) and (1b) apply (prohibitions added by the 2026 amendment); providers of generative AI systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 must comply with Article 50(2) by this date
stages.basis: Reg. 2024/1689, Art. 113(a) and Art. 111(4), as amended/inserted by Reg. 2026/1744

stages.what: Chapter III Sections 1, 2 and 3 apply (high-risk AI systems), except Article 6(5), as regards AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(2) and Annex III
stages.basis: Reg. 2024/1689, Art. 113(c)(i) as amended by Reg. 2026/1744 point (40)
stages.status_note: replaces the original 2 August 2026 application for Annex III systems

stages.what: Chapter III Sections 1, 2 and 3 apply (high-risk AI systems), except Article 6(5), as regards AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(1) and Annex I
stages.basis: Reg. 2024/1689, Art. 113(c)(ii) as amended by Reg. 2026/1744 point (40)
stages.status_note: replaces the original 2 August 2027 application (former Art. 113(c))

ai_act_calendar.note: Dates only, as they stand in the Official Journal. No interpretation. Updated only when a further amendment is published in the OJ.

have_your_say.note: The European Commission consultation portal publishes no official machine-readable feed; this site does not scrape it and does not use undocumented endpoints. Link only.

policy_note: This site observes and lists legal acts and consultations. It never submits feedback or comments to any authority, and listing an act is not an endorsement or criticism of it.
